news.title: Cameron Boozer scores 29 and Grizzlies hand the Wizards an 8th straight loss, 136-120
news.text: — Memphis rookie Cameron Boozer scored a season-high 29 points in a matchup with top draft pick AJ Dybantsa of Washington, and the Grizzlies rallied from 12 points down to hand the Wizards their eighth straight loss, 136-120 on Monday night.

news.title: Grizzlies' GG Jackson to miss time with left foot fracture
news.text: Grizzlies reserve GG Jackson will miss time after breaking a bone in his left foot. He is scheduled to have surgery on the injury.

news.title: Cedric Coward has 23 points and 12 rebounds as Grizzlies beat Nets 129-110
news.text: — Cedric Coward had 23 points and 12 rebounds and Taylor Hendricks scored a career-high 22 as Memphis built an early lead and defeated the Brooklyn Nets 129-110 on Saturday night.
